name: Université Paris-Saclay International Master's Scholarship Program (IDEX)
duration: 1 year for laureates admitted in M2; up to 2 years for laureates admitted in M1 (auto-renews on obtaining all required credits and being admitted to an M2 at Université Paris-Saclay)
eligibleNationalities: Open to students of any foreign nationality (no country list and no EU/EEA restriction). Bangladeshi nationals are eligible. Must meet all cumulative criteria: admission to an eligible Paris-Saclay master's, first-time enrolment in France, and under 30 during the application year.
ageLimit: Under 30 years of age during the year of application
applicationFee: No scholarship application fee; the scholarship form is sent only to candidates pre-selected by course coordinators (the underlying master's admission may have its own application costs)
fundingCovers: Living grant 10,000 euros/year (10 monthly instalments, September-June)
One-off yearly travel and visa flat fee up to 900 euros (amount varies by country of origin)
Support with administrative procedures, visa/residence permits, and accommodation search (accommodation not guaranteed)
monthlyStipend: Approx. 1,000 euros/month (10,000 euros/year over 10 instalments, Sep-Jun); reduced during months spent abroad or on internships outside Paris-Saclay-affiliated labs
bondObligation: None (no return-home service requirement; program merely encourages pursuing a PhD at Paris-Saclay)
renewalConditions: For M1 laureates: automatically renews for a 2nd year only if all required credits are obtained and the student is admitted to an M2 at Université Paris-Saclay. The scholarship stops if the laureate repeats a year. No deferment allowed.
benefits: Living grant of 10,000 euros/year paid in 10 monthly instalments from September to June
One-off yearly travel and visa flat fee up to 900 euros (amount depends on country of origin)
Auto-renewal for a 2nd year for M1 laureates who complete required credits and progress to M2
Support with administrative procedures, visa/residence permit, and accommodation search
Information sessions supporting progression toward PhD study
mustKnow: TUITION IS NOT COVERED: regulations sec. 5.4 states 'Registration and tuition fees are not covered by the international master's scholarship... It is of laureates' responsibility to pay for these fees.' This is a living-stipend award only — not fully funded; a fee discount can only be requested from the enrolling institution at its sole discretion.
Strict age limit: applicant must be under 30 during the year of application.

First-time enrolment in France only: students who have been or are enrolled in a French higher-education institution are ineligible (exceptions: exchange/Erasmus Mundus without a French degree, internships, language programs, or students enrolled in a French institution abroad).
Cannot be combined with any other funding above 600 euros/month, nor with France Excellence Eiffel, France Excellence Europa, or Erasmus Mundus scholarships.

Two-step process: you must first apply to and be admitted to an eligible Paris-Saclay master's BEFORE the scholarship coordinator-selection deadline; only students pre-selected by course coordinators receive the scholarship application-form link — you cannot apply for the scholarship directly.
Merit/PhD-oriented: aimed particularly (not exclusively) at students intending to pursue a PhD; M2 candidates are assessed on motivation for a PhD at Paris-Saclay.
No advance payment: the stipend and travel fee are paid only after arrival in France and registration; no deferment of the scholarship is permitted.

Stipend is reduced or suspended during periods abroad, non-compulsory mobility, or internships outside Paris-Saclay-affiliated labs (incl. internships with stipends over 1,000 euros/month, or any internship abroad).

languageRequirements: Depends on the chosen master's track (both English-taught and French-taught programs exist at Paris-Saclay); the scholarship itself sets no separate language test requirement.
standardizedTests: Not required by the scholarship (no GRE/GMAT requirement)
requiredDocuments: Admission to an eligible Université Paris-Saclay master's (M2 applications via the INCEPTION platform; M1 applications via the relevant national/course platform — apply before the scholarship coordinator-selection deadline)
Statement of purpose / personal project (motivation for the master's and, for M2 candidates, for pursuing a PhD at Paris-Saclay)
Two references (names + contact details of recommenders such as course coordinator, professor, or internship supervisor; references complete their recommendation online when requested)
Completion of the online scholarship application form sent only to candidates pre-selected by course coordinators

timeline.opens: Tied to each master's program's own application opening dates (varies by course; on the INCEPTION platform / relevant master's application platform)
